channel.title: Robotics Directory - Quadruped Robots
channel.description: Browse 134 quadruped robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Astrall Dynamics Hypertron-T01
item.description: Heavy-duty quadruped firefighting robot from Shenzhen-based Astrall Dynamics. The Hypertron-T01 combines an 80 kg dynamic payload, IP67 protection, thermal imaging, gas detection and 3D LiDAR for unmanned suppression and reconnaissance in hazardous environments.

item.title: Dax Robotics Qiji T1000
item.description: Rideable ton-class quadruped robot horse for heavy loads and difficult terrain.

item.title: Satyress Robotics Threehalves
item.description: Teleoperated centaur-style 'superhumanoid' prototype with quadruped base, humanoid torso and horned goat-like head. Quick-connect wrist interface supplies 12/18/48 V power and compressed air to tools such as chainsaws and drills; all limbs swappable and recalibratable in minutes. Passive failsafes: friction-braked joints plus air brakes and pin locks immobilize the robot on pressure loss. Aimed at forestry, wildfire and disaster-zone work; prototype, commercial version 2+ years away.

item.title: xTerra Robotics Svan M2
item.description: India's first commercial quadruped, carbon-fibre 12-DoF for inspection and defence.

item.title: Faraday Future FX Aegis
item.description: Professional embodied-AI quadruped for security and companionship; price and specifications describe the Aegis Pro configuration.

item.title: Faraday Future FX Navi
item.description: Smartphone-powered educational quadruped: 12 joint motors, 46.5x20x51.5 cm, runs on an iOS/Android brain.

item.title: RIVR Milo
item.description: Rebranded from Swiss-Mile, this high-speed wheel-legged quadruped can stand on hind legs to manipulate environments, carrying up to 50kg at speeds up to 22 km/h.

item.title: Unitree AS2-W
item.description: Wheel-legged As2-W family with X and EDU columns. Both list 16 joint motors, 7-inch wheels, about 16 kg walking load and IP54 protection. Charging dock and compute-expansion packages require the selected edition.

item.title: MagicLab MagicDog T1
item.description: Light industrial quadruped shown by MagicLab at WAIC 2026 alongside MagicBot X1 and MagicBot D1; detailed public specifications were not available.

item.title: DEEP Robotics Yunju
item.description: Limited-edition biomimetic robot horse for the Year of the Horse, based on DEEP Robotics' Lynx M20 platform and shown at WAIC 2026; about 30 kg, 50 kg payload and up to 5 m/s.

item.title: UNIUBI AI Lingmao (Cyberling / Cyvet)
item.description: Cyber pet and open development platform with NVIDIA Jetson Orin options, stereo vision, voice interaction, autonomous navigation and 12 high-performance joints; performed the world's first continuous 720° backflip at WAIC 2026.

item.title: Helsing RX-1
item.description: European defense robotics research platform developed by Helsing's Area 9 incubator. Full robotic stack built in-house (hardware and software) for autonomous navigation research in debris-laden and unpredictable environments. Partnerships with ETH Zurich (Marco Hutter group) and INRIA Paris. Designed and owned in Europe.

item.title: Unitree As2 AIR
item.description: As2 AIR is a twelve-joint legged quadruped with about 10 kg continuous-walking load and about 65 N·m peak joint torque. Secondary development is not supported in this variant. Variant-specific battery, perception and accessories are kept separate.

item.title: Unitree As2 PRO
item.description: As2 PRO is a twelve-joint legged quadruped with about 13 kg continuous-walking load and about 75 N·m peak joint torque. Secondary development is not supported in this variant. Variant-specific battery, perception and accessories are kept separate.

item.title: Unitree As2 X
item.description: As2 X is a twelve-joint legged quadruped with about 15 kg continuous-walking load and about 95 N·m peak joint torque. Secondary development is supported. Variant-specific battery, perception and accessories are kept separate.

item.title: Unitree As2 EDU
item.description: As2 EDU is a twelve-joint legged quadruped with about 15 kg continuous-walking load and about 95 N·m peak joint torque. Secondary development is supported. A charging dock and compute expansion are listed for EDU.

item.title: Unitree As2-W X
item.description: As2-W X wheel-legged configuration with 16 joint motors and about 16 kg continuous-walking load. The X column does not list a charging dock or high-compute expansion.

item.title: Unitree As2-W EDU
item.description: As2-W EDU wheel-legged configuration with 16 joint motors and about 16 kg continuous-walking load. EDU lists a charging dock and selectable compute expansion.

item.title: China Mobile Lingxi
item.description: In-house home companion robot dog (灵犀) released Apr 23, 2026 for families with children and elderly members. It offers spatial perception, identity recognition, indoor/outdoor following and about one minute of voice cloning.

item.title: Kepler Robotics Qilin
item.description: Hybrid-drive quadruped (麒麟) for inspection and rescue, unveiled by Kepler at WAIC 2026.

item.title: GLRoad D2-W
item.description: Industrial quadruped robot that can step, glide and crawl. It has an IP67 rating, hot-swappable dual batteries, climbs continuous 25 cm stairs and runs from -20 to 50 °C. It has passed power-grid equipment quality inspection and launched at WRC 2026.

item.title: Elephant Robotics metaCat AI
item.description: LLM-powered, 20+ voice commands, 3 DOF head/tail, touch sensors, LED screen eyes, hypoallergenic fur

item.title: Unitree A2
item.description: A2 industrial quadruped with one LiDAR and one HD camera in the standard table. About 42 kg battery-inclusive mass, dual hot-swappable batteries and load-specific walking endurance support development and inspection configurations.

item.title: MagicLab MagicDog
item.description: 13 DOF companion quadruped, 3 m/s, 5 kg payload, 4K and depth cameras, swappable battery

item.title: MagicLab MagicDog-W
item.description: Wheel-foot hybrid quadruped, 17 joint motors, 3 m/s, 10 kg payload, 60 cm obstacles, 4 h runtime

item.title: Hengbot Sirius
item.description: 1 kg AI robot dog, 14 DOF, LLM multimodal interaction, 5 TOPS edge AI, open-source programmable

item.title: Kawasaki CORLEO
item.description: Rideable hydrogen-powered quadruped unveiled at Expo 2025 Osaka; rider steers via weight shift

item.title: RT Corporation Mujina
item.description: Japanese-made ROS2 open-hardware quadruped for surveillance, inspection and surveying R&D.

item.title: Vbot Big Head BoBo
item.description: Consumer robot dog needing no remote, 128 TOPS onboard AI compute.

item.title: Yahboom DOGZILLA-Lite
item.description: Desktop 15-DOF AI robot dog with arm, gripper and large-model dialogue.

item.title: Qiteng Robot X3
item.description: China's first certified explosion-proof quadruped for petrochemical inspection.

item.title: IntuiCell Luna
item.description: Swedish robot dog learning in real time via a digital nervous system.

item.title: Mirror Me Black Panther 2.0
item.description: Cheetah-inspired quadruped running 100 meters in under ten seconds.

item.title: EngineAI JS01
item.description: Heavy-duty quadruped robotic leopard with adaptive shock-absorbing joints, LiDAR, wide-angle vision, IMU, SLAM navigation and a modular expansion platform for inspection, emergency response and logistics.

item.title: Unitree A2-PRO
item.description: A2-PRO industrial quadruped with two LiDAR units and one HD camera. Configuration-dependent IP56-IP67 protection distinguishes core components from the whole robot. Dual hot-swappable batteries support continued operation.

item.title: Dobot Rover X1
item.description: Wheel-legged home robot dog announced Nov 3, 2025 as a 'household agent robot'. It has dual-vision tracking, UWB following, a modular cargo system, and modes for following, security, coding education and companionship.

item.title: Yobotics Y20-W
item.description: Industrial wheel-legged all-terrain flagship from Shandong Yobotics (优宝特), launched in 2025. It has 4 DOF per leg, an IP67 rating, 45° slope climbing, obstacle clearance of 1 m or more, and runs from -20 to 55 °C.

item.title: Weilan BabyAlpha A2
item.description: 100+ expressions, 40 biomimetic movements, AI voice interaction

item.title: Unitree Go2-W
item.description: Wheeled Go2: in-wheel motors with 7-inch tires, lidar perception, 8 kg payload, 35° ramps

item.title: Unitree B2-W
item.description: B2-W wheel-legged industrial platform weighs about 85 kg including battery. Manufacturer lists 15 km/h and 25 km with 40 kg load for special configurations; distance is not battery operating time.

item.title: MAB Robotics Honey Badger 4.0
item.description: Amphibious IP67 quadruped, walks underwater, 12 kg, 2 kg payload, thermal/gas sensors, 5G

item.title: Raion Robotics RAIBO2
item.description: KAIST spin-off quadruped, first robot to finish a full marathon.

item.title: Lenovo Daystar Bot GS
item.description: Six-legged industrial inspection robot from Lenovo's Daystar line. It is IP66-rated, has a modular mount for sensors and arms, and was aimed at trade, industry and the public sector.

item.title: Unitree Go2
item.description: Go2 quadruped family with AIR, PRO, X and EDU configurations. Standing dimensions and approximate battery-inclusive mass are common in the manufacturer table; price, payload, speed, endurance and development access require a selected variant.

item.title: Unitree B2
item.description: B2 legged industrial platform weighs about 60 kg including battery. Walking endurance depends on load; wheel conversion and autonomous charging are optional. Some functions require human operation or secondary development.

item.title: Unitree Go2 Pro
item.description: Go2 PRO quadruped with 4D LiDAR and camera. Listed with an 8000 mAh standard battery; graphical programming is distinct from full secondary-development access. Manufacturer performance figures are configuration and condition dependent.

item.title: Xiaomi CyberDog 2
item.description: Xiaomi CyberDog 2 - specifications, images and comparison in the Robotics Directory.

item.title: Petoi Bittle X
item.description: 9 DOF, open source, 35+ voice commands, LEGO compatible

item.title: Hiwonder PuppyPi
item.description: The Hiwonder PuppyPi is an 8 DOF quadruped robot built on a Raspberry Pi 4B or 5 with coreless servos and a 3 DOF robotic arm. It measures 226 x 149 x 190 mm and weighs 720 g. A 7.4 V 2,200 mAh LiPo battery powers the robot; no runtime in minutes or charging time is published. It supports ROS1 and ROS2, Python, a 480P camera and app or wireless-handle control, and the arm adds colour recognition, target tracking and object transport. It costs 589.99 USD. No payload, travel speed or IP rating is published; the catalog 700 USD price, ~1.5 kg mass, small size label, ~2 hours battery and 120 min runtime are replaced or cleared.

item.title: Unitree Go2-EDU
item.description: Go2 EDU quadruped with 4D LiDAR and camera. EDU includes a 15000 mAh long-endurance battery, depth camera and secondary-development support. Manufacturer performance figures are configuration and condition dependent.
